decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed two-storey side extension and part single storey front extension would by reason of its position, design and appearance, represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature, out of keeping with the character of the existing pair of semi detached houses and detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed two storey side extension and part single storey front extension would, by reason of its position, size and appearance, have a significant adverse impact on the outlook of the adjoining neighbours, detrimental to the amenities currently enjoyed by the adjoining neighbours. The proposal is contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4. and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension incorporating part single storey front and integral garage
